mapper.sql: S.SBJCT_YR , SC.SMSTR_CHRTNM AS SBJCT_SMSTR , O.ORGNM , S.SBJCTNM , S.DVCLAS_NO , U.USER_TYCD , U.STDNT_NO , U.USERNM , (SELECT MAX(UC.CNTCT) FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT UC WHERE UC.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN') AS MBL_PHN , (SELECT MAX(UC.CNTCT) FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT UC WHERE UC.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'INDV_EML') AS EML , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(NVL(U.PUSH_TALK_SMS_FLAG, '0000000000'), 4, 1) = '1' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PUSH_RCVYN , U.SHRTNT_ALIM_RCVYN , U.EML_ALIM_RCVYN , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(NVL(U.PUSH_TALK_SMS_FLAG, '0000000000'), 6, 1) = '1' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ALIM_TALK_RCVYN , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(NVL(U.PUSH_TALK_SMS_FLAG, '0000000000'), 1, 1) = '1' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SMS_RCVYN

NULL AS SBJCT_YR , NULL AS SBJCT_SMSTR , O.ORGNM , ( SELECT LISTAGG(S2.SBJCTNM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY S2.SBJCTNM) FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT S2 WHERE S2.DELYN = 'N' AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM ADM WHERE ADM.SBJCT_ID = S2.SBJCT_ID AND ADM.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD = 'PROF' AND ADM.USER_ID = U.USER_ID ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC A2 WHERE A2.SBJCT_ID = S2.SBJCT_ID AND A2.USER_ID = U.USER_ID ) ) ) AS SBJCTNM , NULL AS DVCLAS_NO , U.USER_TYCD , U.STDNT_NO , U.USERNM , (SELECT MAX(UC.CNTCT) FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT UC WHERE UC.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN') AS MBL_PHN , (SELECT MAX(UC.CNTCT) FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT UC WHERE UC.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'INDV_EML') AS EML , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(NVL(U.PUSH_TALK_SMS_FLAG, '0000000000'), 4, 1) = '1' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PUSH_RCVYN , U.SHRTNT_ALIM_RCVYN , U.EML_ALIM_RCVYN , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(NVL(U.PUSH_TALK_SMS_FLAG, '0000000000'), 6, 1) = '1' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ALIM_TALK_RCVYN , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(NVL(U.PUSH_TALK_SMS_FLAG, '0000000000'), 1, 1) = '1' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SMS_RCVYN

FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC A INNER JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON A.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID INNER JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON A.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ORG O ON SC.ORG_ID = O.ORG_ID WHERE S.DELYN = 'N'

FROM TB_LMS_USER U LEFT JOIN ( SELECT UA.USER_ID, MAX(UA.ORG_ID) AS ORG_ID FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UA GROUP BY UA.USER_ID ) UAO ON UAO.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ORG O ON O.ORG_ID = UAO.ORG_ID WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT NULL AS SBJCT_YR , NULL AS SBJCT_SMSTR , O.ORGNM , NULL AS SBJCTNM , NULL AS DVCLAS_NO , U.USER_TYCD , U.STDNT_NO , U.USERNM , (SELECT MAX(UC.CNTCT) FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT UC WHERE UC.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN') AS MBL_PHN , (SELECT MAX(UC.CNTCT) FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT UC WHERE UC.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'INDV_EML') AS EML , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(NVL(U.PUSH_TALK_SMS_FLAG, '0000000000'), 4, 1) = '1' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PUSH_RCVYN , U.SHRTNT_ALIM_RCVYN , U.EML_ALIM_RCVYN , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(NVL(U.PUSH_TALK_SMS_FLAG, '0000000000'), 6, 1) = '1' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ALIM_TALK_RCVYN , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(NVL(U.PUSH_TALK_SMS_FLAG, '0000000000'), 1, 1) = '1' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SMS_RCVYN FROM TB_LMS_USER U LEFT JOIN ( SELECT UA.USER_ID, MAX(UA.ORG_ID) AS ORG_ID FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UA GROUP BY UA.USER_ID ) UAO ON UAO.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ORG O ON O.ORG_ID = UAO.ORG_ID WHERE U.USER_TYCD = 'PROF' AND U.USER_ID != #{userId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UA_P WHERE UA_P.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UA_P.ORG_ID = #{orgId} )
AND U.USERNM LIKE FN_LIKE_VAL(#{searchText})
AND U.STDNT_NO LIKE FN_LIKE_VAL(#{searchText})
